text:
Doctor: Namaste, kya problem ho rahi hai aapko?
Patient: Namaste doctor, mujhe 3 din se fever aa raha hai.
Doctor: Fever constant hai ya aata jaata hai?
Patient: Thoda aata jaata hai, par kal se headache bhi start ho gaya hai.
Doctor: Body pain ya weakness feel ho rahi hai?
Patient: Haan doctor, body pain hai aur kaafi weakness bhi lag rahi hai.
Doctor: Koi medicine li hai abhi tak?
Patient: Maine paracetamol liya tha 500 mg, din mein do baar.
Doctor: Thoda relief mila?
Patient: Thoda sa, par fever fir bhi aa jaata hai.
Doctor: Koi cold, cough ya sore throat?
Patient: Thoda cough hai aur halka sore throat bhi hai.
Doctor: Aapko kisi se infection hua ho sakta hai?
Patient: Shayad office mein kisi ko viral tha.
Doctor: Theek hai, lagta hai viral infection hai.
Patient: Isme kya karna hoga doctor?
Doctor: Aap rest lo, hydration maintain karo aur medicines continue karo.
Doctor: Main aapko ek antibiotic aur vitamin tablets likh deta hoon.
Patient: Kitne din tak lena hoga?
Doctor: 5 din tak medicines lo aur 3-4 din bed rest karo.
Patient: Theek hai doctor, thank you.
symptoms_pred: fever, headache, body pain, weakness, cough, sore throat
summary_pred: Patient has viral infection with symptoms of fever, headache, body pain, weakness, cough, and sore throat, and is advised to take paracetamol, antibiotic, and vitamin tablets for 5 days with bed rest for 3-4 days.
